purpose: One targeted first-backward loss-memory repair after a recorded over-cap failed fit; no recipe/prompt/data or quality sweep.
trainingSelection: The 11 frozen Haryana/Bihar teacher v2 examples, independently checked to append only the mandatory no_canonical_targets abstention and correction provenance. All input/claim/conflict/existing decision sections and v1/rejects are unchanged.

settings.loss: assistant JSON target plus EOS only; all prompt tokens masked

lengthPolicy: Measure each exact compact prompt/target/combined token count under the contained pinned runtime. Never truncate or silently exclude a teacher row. Any bound or resource issue returns exact evidence before a changed fit configuration.
comparison: Fresh process loads the exact same frozen base plus saved local safetensors adapter. Reuse both frozen development inputs, expectations, original prompt and generation settings. Keep raw output/projection/adapter receipt distinct; no model-output repair or development-derived training targets.

developmentCriteriaBeforeEvaluation.resourcesAndCleanup: all existing measured bounds and containment/cleanup checks pass
developmentCriteriaBeforeEvaluation.interpretation: Tiny source-native development acceptance only. No promotion or generalization qualification; evaluation is a later separately frozen candidate task. A failed fit remains useful recorded evidence.

teacherFeedback: Training examples/output errors only; never development/evaluation content or predictions.
settingsRequired: Astra/max latest human override; default/standard required, per-turn tier unexposed

memoryExecutionPolicy.implementation: One decoder forward; select the same assistant-predicting hidden positions; frozen lm_head projection and float32 summed cross-entropy in 64-token checkpointed chunks; sum chunk losses and divide by exact total supervised tokens including EOS. Avoid storing full vocabulary logits/float copy/backward buffers.
memoryExecutionPolicy.checkpointing: Non-reentrant recomputation for deterministic frozen projection/loss; preserve stochastic decoder/LoRA RNG behavior. No target truncation, per-chunk reweighting or independent example splitting.
memoryExecutionPolicy.equivalence: One contained small tensor control compares full versus chunked loss and hidden gradients, including a short last chunk, under predefined dtype-appropriate tolerances. This is an objective-preservation check, not a training/corpus campaign.
memoryExecutionPolicy.instrumentation: Flush numeric finite loss and first-step phase native Job committed/peak, RSS and GPU allocation/reservation/free observations before/after load, forward/loss, backward and optimizer. Preserve original exception and report last observed samples honestly if CUDA becomes unhealthy.
memoryExecutionPolicy.continuation: One freshly pinned execution. If the original failing first update completes under bounds, finish the unchanged 66-step fit in that bounded phase, save/check adapter, then fresh-process reload and original development comparison. Any consequential failure returns exact artifacts; do not change cap/attention/model/rank/epochs/data/prompt or launch a search.
memoryExecutionPolicy.causeQualification: Full logits/float loss tensors are a code-inspected avoidable allocation. Recorded Job over-cap disqualifies prior fit; precise native allocator/CUDA failure cause remains unresolved.
